00-aujourdhui: Today, we're learning the letter f.
02-regarde: Watch how we write the f.
03-depart: We start on the green dot. We go up in a curve, and we make a big loop to the LEFT, right at the top. We come straight back down, we go BELOW the line, and we make a second loop, a smaller one, to the RIGHT. It comes back to rest on the line, and we finish with one last curve. All in one go, without lifting the pencil!
04-encore: One more time, a little faster.
05-cherchons: Now, let's find words that begin with f.
10-pareil: Did you hear? They all begin the same way.
11-relance: Find a word that begins with f.
